description: Ironsight re-roll: v1 drifted to a clean human-in-a-catsuit. Chassis-hard prompt (synthetic faceplate, corroded mechanical android chassis) + human-realism/sleek-clean hard-negated, so she reads as a grimy decommissioned ANDROID vet. Fresh seeds.
